1.consolidated_definition: En su libro Cosas de Puerto Rico, I, p. 21, usa Daubón, con sentido que no explica, el término maquimbamba como adjetivo aplicado a persona. “Era el Tío Gabriel un negro maquimbamba, maestro de pala de la panadería de don Jaime Cladellas.” Es probable que sea dicha voz creación caprichosa del citado autor (tal vez fabricada de quimbamba con prefijación de ma- sugerido por mandinga) para expresar la idea de bozal o negro nacido en África.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In his book Cosas de Puerto Rico, I, p. 21, Daubón uses the term maquimbamba as an adjective applied to a person with a sense that is not explained. "He was Uncle Gabriel a black maquimbamba, a master of the paddle at Don Jaime Cladellas' bakery." It is likely that this voice is a whimsical creation of the aforementioned author (perhaps fabricated from quimbamba with a prefix suggested by mandinga) to express the idea of being mute or a black person born in Africa.
